title: Glass Loyalty Allowance on Calibration Goodwill, Workmanship Warranties
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, a calibration glass-loyalty allowance is added into the calibration goodwill sum on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty. The calibration glass-loyalty allowance follows the customer payments recorded on the customer's network glass jobs under Auto Glass Services less than thirty-six whole calendar months before the goodwill date.

| Customer payments on the customer's Auto Glass Services jobs, less than 36 whole calendar months before the goodwill date | Calibration glass-loyalty allowance |
|---|---|
| two or more | the two-payment glass-loyalty allowance, USD 4.00 |
| exactly one | the one-payment glass-loyalty allowance, USD 2.00 |
| none | no calibration glass-loyalty allowance |

## Schedule notes

- **What counts.** Each customer payment recorded on the money history of any of the customer's network glass jobs counts as one payment.
- **Window.** A payment counts when its entry date is less than 36 whole calendar months before the date the goodwill is figured; an older payment does not count.
- **Count, not amount.** The allowance turns on the number of payments, not on their amounts.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Two customer payments on one windshield replacement job, both within the last 36 whole months: two payments, USD 4.00.
- One customer payment on a chip repair 20 months ago and one on a side glass job 40 months ago: one payment counts, USD 2.00.
- Glass jobs paid entirely by an insurer's glass program, with no customer payment recorded: no allowance.
